description: Defines a thread-safe template class 'SessionMap' for managing session data pointers, using Android utils like KeyedVector and Mutex. Provides methods for adding, retrieving, removing, and managing session objects identified by session IDs.

classes.name: SessionMap
classes.description: A thread-safe template class for managing session pointers, allowing addition, retrieval, removal, and size queries of session data.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a new session pointer to the map if the key does not already exist.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Retrieves the session pointer associated with a given session ID.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of session objects stored.

methods.name: getValueAt
methods.description: Retrieves the session pointer at a specific index.

methods.name: removeValue
methods.description: Removes a session pointer by session ID and frees its memory.

methods.name: isCreated
methods.description: Checks if a session with the given ID exists.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assigns one SessionMap to another, copying the internal map.
